subject: Pilot economics sanity check — monthly spend corridor & PO trigger calibration
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@zettabytehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot economics sanity check — monthly spend corridor & PO trigger calibration

Hi Ava — thanks again for the call today, appreciate you walking us through the MAAP pilot goals. Quick recap and a couple asks so we can align legal/procurement and sizing on our side: 

Recap (from our notes):
- Pilot window: 3 months, ~50k–150k monthly inference tokens (aggregate across internal and external traffic).
- Latency target: 200–250ms p95 (interactive features).
- Primary concerns: unit $/1M token, procurement lead time, and PO threshold for finance.

As discussed, to put together a clean pilot quote and an SOW we need two things from your side:
1) A validated monthly spend band that procurement would sign off on (we use this to recommend a reserved capacity vs. metered approach). Example bands we typically present: <$5k/mo, $5–25k/mo, $25–75k/mo, >$75k/mo.
2) The procurement trigger — i.e., at what monthly spend does ZettaByte require a PO/contract vs. credit-card/expense approval? If you can share the dollar threshold and any required procurement lead-times that would be super helpful.

Proposed unit-econ starting point for discussion: $14–18 per 1M tokens (generation + embeddings blended) for the pilot band of 50k–150k tokens/mo. We can tighten this once you confirm the target band and whether you want reserved capacity.

Attachments: I attached a simple estimate workbook and a draft SOW for timeline/roles. [attachment: Zetta_MAAP_estimate_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)] [attachment: SOW-draft-connor-20270523.pdf (pdf, 22KB)]

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred monthly band and PO threshold by EOD Monday 24th.
- If PO required, we'll prepare a minimal SOW + PO-ready quote; if not, we'll set up the pilot onboarding with our solutions engineer.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min follow if it's easier.

Best,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@zettabytehealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@zettabytehealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot economics sanity check — monthly spend corridor & PO trigger calibration

Connor — thanks for the clear recap and for the files. Quick answers from procurement and finance: 

- Target monthly band: our expected consumption for the pilot is ~35k–120k tokens/mo; finance is comfortable categorizing this in the $5k–25k band initially but wants a contingency plan if it spikes past $25k.
- PO threshold: ZettaByte requires a PO for any committed spend > $10,000/mo or single-contract commitments > $50,000. For pilots paid on a card, approvals are self-serve up to ~$5k/mo.
- Procurement lead time: formal PO process takes ~7–10 business days once the SOW and quote are approved; expedited processing (business justification) can shave that to ~3 days.

On unit economics: the $14–18 / 1M tokens range looks reasonable as a starting point. Two asks from our side: (1) please indicate a short-term overflow policy if we spike (auto-burst to hosted with a cap or fallback model), and (2) include a clear rollback/fallback clause in the SOW in case latency or cost targets are not met.

Happy to approve moving forward on a card up to $5k/mo while procurement runs the PO in parallel if that helps accelerate kick-off.

— Ava
Director, Product — ZettaByte Health
ava.reynolds@zettabytehealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot economics sanity check — monthly spend corridor & PO trigger calibration

Connor / Grace — quick internal alignment based on Ava's reply:

Observations:
- ZettaByte expects pilot to drift within our $5k–25k band but procurement wants a PO at >$10k/mo. That creates a window where credit-card start is possible but we should have PO-ready docs if they cross the $10k mark.
- Their ask for overflow policy and rollback clause is standard — add an explicit burst cap (e.g., max 2x baseline for 72 hours) and an SLA escape clause for unsatisfactory p95 latency.

Proposed actions:
1) Edit the SOW to include: burst-to-hosted rule (auto-burst to hosted fallback, capped at 2x estimated monthly tokens for pilot duration) + notification/approval workflow.
2) Produce two quotes: (A) card/credit start (no PO) at blended $/1M tokens = $17, and (B) PO-ready committed quote (30-day invoice) with a 10% discount at $15.3 / 1M tokens assuming they commit to a 3-month pilot volume within the stated band.
3) Connor to propose: card start up to $5k/mo while procurement processes PO; if spend exceeds $10k/mo, we convert to PO quote and apply retroactive discount for that month if they sign PO within the month.

I'll draft language for the SOW and the two-quote table this morning.

-Jordan
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@zettabytehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@zettabytehealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot economics sanity check — monthly spend corridor & PO trigger calibration

Thanks Ava — this is perfect and gives procurement what they need. 

I updated the SOW and attached two quote options per Jordan's suggestion. Summary below: 

Option A — Card start (fast onboarding)
- Blended price: $17 / 1M tokens
- Start on card up to $5k/mo (no PO)
- Overflow policy: auto-burst to hosted fallback, capped at 2x estimated monthly tokens for up to 72 hours, notifications to product + procurement

Option B — PO/Committed (30-day invoice)
- Committed pilot quote (3 months): $15.30 / 1M tokens (10% off)
- PO required if monthly spend > $10k; procurement lead time ~7–10 business days
- SLA rollback clause: termination/right to pause if monthly p95 latency > 350ms for two consecutive weeks with remediation plan

Attached: updated SOW and two-quote worksheet. If this matches your internal requirements I can get procurement-facing pricing into a PO-ready PDF and route it to your procurement mailbox.

Next step: Ava — can you confirm whether you prefer we: (1) start on card up to $5k/mo while procurement runs the PO, or (2) hold for PO before any usage? If (1) please confirm billing card and contact; if (2) share expected PO submit date and the procurement contact and we'll queue a DocuSign-ready packet.

Thanks — attaching files again. [attachment: Zetta_MAAP_estimate_v2.xlsx (updated) (xlsx, 52KB)] [attachment: SOW-draft-connor-20270525.pdf (pdf, 28KB)]

Best,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
